sourcePolicy.method: Manual reading of official Central University of Tamil Nadu pages and PDFs; no authentication, CAPTCHA, access-control or rate-limit bypass and no automated bulk fetch.
sourcePolicy.factualUse: Stage only concise structured facts and exact source links/locators. No document or substantial source wording/table is stored. Public visibility and attribution do not establish bulk reuse permission.
sourcePolicy.reuseConditions: CUTN's IT policy says users need copyright-holder permission to use other publishers' text, graphics or multimedia on personal pages and requires written authorization for third-party content distribution through University IT resources. This is not an express licence for CollegeFind's use and does not specifically determine rights in individual facts. The pilot records isolated factual values, not expressive descriptions, source tables or documents. Keep these claims unreviewed; reviewer/legal owner should decide whether the proposed public factual summary complies with applicable rights and current terms before approval. Do not expand to automated/bulk collection without a separate terms review.

The cycle was explicitly closed on 2026-08-21, so all cycle claims are historical and the three eligibility claims carry validUntil. The B.Sc. Materials Science candidate from the eligibility table was not staged because a linked CUTN corrigendum withdraws that programme; the page's distinct B.Tech Materials Science and Technology entry remains in the list. Fee, hostel, scholarship, placement and accreditation facts were not asserted. Keep all claims unreviewed, verify campus scope and assess public factual reuse before approval.
